continuity.narrative_arc: Adult gopikas approach Krishna; his dharma teaching is heard by sages in the sky, they plead, and he joins them in modest devotional companionship beside the moonlit Yamuna. They receive a symbolic assurance and share bliss; the final stanza turns to Bhattathiri’s prayer for relief from illness.
continuity.krishna_identity: Use the D062 provisional youthful Vraja cowherd identity: deep-blue matte skin, serene youthful face, dark wavy hair, restrained peacock feather, yellow dhoti and muted red-orange upper cloth, with ordinary youthful two-arm/two-leg anatomy. The cue is provisional and does not imply D066 art approval. No infant face or proportions.
continuity.gopika_contract: Use the existing gopikas character bible: distinct adult women with natural proportions and simple village dress. For every D066 scene, keep them modestly and fully clothed in opaque garments. The clothing-promise verse is represented symbolically; never depict undressing, nudity, exposed bodies, sexualized framing, or a clothing theft in progress.
continuity.celestial_sages_contract: Only S002 includes sages, because stanza 2 says Krishna speaks so the gathered sages in the sky can hear. Render a small, distinct group of ordinary ascetics as distant witnesses, with one head and two arms each; do not turn them into deities or clone them.
continuity.deity_contract: S001–S009 use one youthful, two-armed Krishna in narrative mode, with no unrequested four-armed forms. S010 shows a restrained serene blue two-armed divine presence receiving Bhattathiri’s prayer; only a face-level identity cue may be used, without transferring any deity reference’s body, pose, crown or ornaments.
continuity.bhattathiri_contract: S010 depicts the older clean-shaven Bhattathiri only: lined face, sacred ash marks, small traditional hair tuft, simple cream Kerala dhoti, sacred thread and modest prayer beads. The selected reference is an identity candidate only, not an approved master.
